item.tib: man ngag nyi ma'i sgron ma
item.coloph: man ngag nyi ma'i sgron ma 'di/ rig 'dzin kun gyi dgongs pa'i bcus (bcud) bsdus te/ gnas mchog dam pa 'ol mo lung rings su (ring du/)sprul sku tshe dbang rig 'dzin chen po'i (pos/)nges med shel zhig mi shig rdo rje rtsal la/ man ngag dam pa nyi ma'i sgron ma rgyud/ bka' rgya dam pas gsang sbas thub pa byas/ dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskul pa'i ngor/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyongs (skyong) srung ma rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba'i 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog sa ya ma/ rgya rgya rgya/ rgya rgya rgya/ rgya rgya rgya/ ag tham//
